title: fix(console): save a language picked on the register page as the new person's own when they have none
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuTbUduB1ABMv1ARhxiJJCEa)_
Fixes #30338

domain:ui#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWn6zhNa4LL7VB1rtL

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：在注册页底部选了语言、本人还没设过语言偏好的，注册即登录时这个选择会存成本人的语言偏好（`sys_user.locale`），和登录页（#30399）一样；从邀请链接注册加入组织也一样。
- 为什么改：#30399 只改了登录页；注册页同样靠整页跳转离开，跳转前没人写库，选的语言只留在这台浏览器上。
- 风险与回滚：只有注册页选过语言才多发两次请求（读一次本人记录、写一次），已有偏好不改，没选不发不等，写失败照常进入。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：console `RegisterPage.tsx` 注册后 effect 新增的第 0 步；app-shell `RegisterPage.tsx` 的 `holdForSignInPick`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/registerLanguagePick-30338.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/registerLanguagePick-30338.test.tsx`，预期 25 passed。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/RegisterPage.tsx`, the post-signup orchestration effect only: a new step 0, the same as `LoginPage`'s (#30539). When a language was picked on the page while signed out, it starts app-shell's `saveSignInLanguagePick` once (ref latch), holds the spinner, and re-runs the effect when the save settles (state). The steps after it are unchanged, so every exit waits:

  | Exit | Line on `main` | Waits |
  |---|---|---|
  | OAuth provider hand-off (`followOauthAuthorize`) | L194 | yes (step 0 sits above it, as on `/login`) |
  | Mobile sign-in hand-off | L206 | yes; a session the hand-off refuses for its age saves nothing |
  | Invitation join entered (#30125) | L218 | yes; the acceptance runs meanwhile |
  | No organization | L233 | yes |
  | Several organizations | L236 | yes |
  | Final redirect after the single-org auto-select | L241 | yes |

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/RegisterPage.tsx` (`DefaultRegisterPage`): this page draws no language menu, so a pick reaches it only from another signed-out page earlier in the same page-load. Once someone is signed in and a pick is held, the page starts the save once and renders its empty layout until it settles (`holdForSignInPick`, from state plus `hasSignInLanguagePick()`, so the render that first sees the user already holds). That covers its three ways out: the invitation join's `window.location.assign` to the root (L132), the signed-in branch's `Navigate` to `/`, and the form's `onSuccess` `navigate('/')` (L271), which now leaves the move to the signed-in branch when a pick is held or its save has started.
- Imports only: `hasSignInLanguagePick` / `saveSignInLanguagePick` as #30539 landed them. No new export, no new storage key, nothing sent beside a navigation.

## Why

Measured on `origin/main` `27b0bc79`: neither register page called `saveSignInLanguagePick`, and both leave by navigation after a sign-up that signs the person in, so a pick made there stayed in the device slot only. This is the remainder recorded in the `domain:ui#4` ACCEPT on #30539 ("`RegisterPage.tsx` 同形") and claimed in 6663446873.

## Acceptance notes

- **Bound, as ruled (seat ruling D on this card, carried by the claim):** memory lasts one page-load. A pick followed by a reload of the register page, or by an identity provider round trip, is still not saved. No storage marker was added to change that.
- **No timeout on the save**, the same as `/login`: a hanging request keeps the spinner up as long as the adapter's own fetch does.
- **Write census:** no new adapter write call site. The pages call `saveSignInLanguagePick`, whose own `update` is already registered in `affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx` (`outOfFamily`), and that function is not a census write helper. The census test ran green unchanged.
- **Observed, not this card's:** with no pick and several organizations, the post-signup step navigates to the root before the organization list answers, then again to the picker, the same double navigation #30539 noted on `/login`. The CONTROL pins assert only that the page leaves and saves nothing.
- Untouched: `LoginPage.tsx`, `useUserLocale.ts`, `loadLocales.ts`'s signed-out list, `packages/**`.
- Branch `claude/project-thread-b4xtgz` is the card thread's platform-assigned branch (not `claude/issue-30338-*`).

## Tests

- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/__tests__/registerLanguagePick-30338.test.tsx` (new, 19 cases, each reached by a sign-up on the form): for each of the six exits, nothing leaves while the save is in flight and the expected exit is taken once it settles; the invitation join accepts its invitation and still waits; CONTROL for each exit with no pick; for each exit, a save that settles having failed still lets the page leave.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/__tests__/registerLanguagePick-30338.test.tsx` (new, 6 cases): sign-up to `/` and invitation join to the root each wait for the save; CONTROL for both with no pick; a failed save still moves on, both ways.

<details><summary>vitest: both new files, every console and app-shell auth page test, the sign-in pick hook file and the write census (head e15bb2eb)</summary>

```
pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/src/pages/auth/ packages/app-shell/src/console/auth/ packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/userLocaleSignInPick-30338.test.tsx packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx
 Test Files  47 passed (47)
      Tests  404 passed (404)
exit 0
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (each through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, mutation proven on disk, restored: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

```
A1 console RegisterPage: drop step 0's return (the save starts, the first effect run goes on to the exit)
   registerLanguagePick-30338 (console): 8 failed | 11 passed (19), exit 1
   red: the five non-invitation "waits" cases and three "failed save" cases; green: CONTROLs and both invitation cases
   (a later effect run still meets the 'saving' guard, so the invitation exit stays held: hence A1b)
A1b console RegisterPage: delete the "save in flight" guard line
   registerLanguagePick-30338 (console): 4 failed | 15 passed (19), exit 1
   red: several organizations, one organization, both invitation cases
A2 app-shell RegisterPage: holdForSignInPick forced false
   registerLanguagePick-30338 (app-shell): 2 failed | 4 passed (6), exit 1
   red: both "waits" cases; green: CONTROLs and both failed-save cases
```
Together every exit has a waits case that goes red when the wait is removed.
</details>

<details><summary>Type check</summary>

```
pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check   (tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json)   exit 0
ui/apps/console: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144 tsc --noEmit   exit 0
eslint on the four changed files: 0 errors; 2 warnings, both present on main (setState in effect, L145 and L258)
```
</details>

## Verification

Live: showcase `pnpm dev -- --fresh` (invite_only) plus the console on vite, Playwright `zh-CN`, 1440 wide. The seeded admin invites a fresh address; the invitee opens the link signed out, follows "注册并加入", picks Français in the register page's footer menu, registers, and lands in the app. Then, from the invitee's own session: `sys_user.locale`, the device slot, the document's `lang` attribute. Before = this head with the console `RegisterPage.tsx` restored from `27b0bc79` (vite reads source), put back from HEAD after (`git status` clean). Script and screenshots: project files `issue-30338/`.

| Row | Picked | Landed | `sys_user.locale` | Slot | `lang` |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | Français | app, joined | empty | fr | fr |
| after | Français | app, joined | **fr** | fr | fr |
| after, CONTROL | nothing | app, joined | empty, no `PATCH` sent | empty | zh-CN |

Requests in the after row, in order: `POST sign-up/email`, `GET get-invitation`, `POST accept-invitation`, `POST set-active`, and on the data side `GET discovery`, `GET sys_user/ID`, `PATCH sys_user/ID`, then the next page-load's `GET discovery`.

Changed lines 619, under the 3000 threshold.
